title: Kapamilya stars, golfers tee off for ABS-CBN Foundation fundraiser
summary: Kapamilya stars and golf enthusiasts came together on Monday at the Canlubang Golf and Country Club for the second year of 'Swing for a Cause,' a fundraiser tournament for the ABS-CBN Foundation.
